117:t_1:86.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(You go, $n. Go and ask Miss $$スズネ$$ what's on her mind.)

117:t_1:87.en:
$n
(I was going to, even without you telling me.)

117:t_1:88.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(You used to shy away from this, but you've become more forward.)

117:t_1:89.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(Did happily married $$コーラサワー$$ inspire you?)

117:t_1:92.en:
$n
(I... want to get to know Miss $$スズネ$$ better. We're partners, but... I know nothing about her.)

117:t_1:93.en:
$$刹那$$
(I think it's important to try to understand someone... to think about them.)

117:t_1:94.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Good luck, $n. Miss $$スズネ$$ keeps our spirits up, so if she's feeling down, it affects our morale too.)

117:t_1:95.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What's going on, everyone? Are you trying to recruit $n into $$ソレスタルビーイング$$?」

117:t_1:96.en:
$n
「If that happened, would you come with me too, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

117:t_1:97.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What should I do...? If I did that, I'd have to give up my dream of being a teacher...」

117:t_1:98.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I can't just leave you on your own, $n. We're partners, after all.」

117:t_1:99.en:
$n
「Then tell me too. Tell me what you were thinking when $$オーティス$$ came up earlier.」

117:t_1:101.en:
$n
「Ah... Um... I'm not trying to force you, but...」

117:t_1:102.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(What are you doing...?! How can you get anywhere if you're that timid?!)

117:t_1:103.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Keep quiet, $$ロックオン$$.)

117:t_1:105.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(Watching $n seems to bring out your knack for drawing the short straw.)

117:t_1:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We're partners... I need to tell you what's really in my heart, don't I...?」

117:t_1:109.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I told you before that I came from a world that was neither $$ＵＣＷ$$ nor $$ＡＤＷ$$, right?」

117:t_1:111.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The truth is... I hardly have any memories of that world left...」

117:t_1:113.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I remembered the spoken name $$西条涼音$$, but I wasn't even sure which kanji it was written with...」

117:t_1:114.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And among my few memories was the sight of a town attacked by $$次元獣$$, just like $$オーティス$$...」

117:t_1:116.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know whether that was my own experience... But when I heard about $$オーティス$$, I couldn't think of it as someone else's problem...」

117:t_1:119.en:
$n
「If you can't see it as someone else's problem, let's think of $$オーティス$$ as your hometown and liberate it.」

117:t_1:121.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll save that town for $$エスター$$... and for myself...」

117:t_1:123.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe... You stole my big line.」

117:t_1:124.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(Yes...! Yes! You did great, $n...!)

117:t_1:125.en:
$$刹那$$
(Is that what it means to understand each other...?)

117:t_1:127.en:
$$マリー$$
(Yes, let's. We shouldn't get in their way.)

117:t_1:128.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Let's do everything we can to fight for $$オーティス$$'s liberation too.)

117:t_1:129.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Thank you, $n. You helped me make up my mind.」

117:t_1:130.en:
$n
「Am I acting a little more like your partner now?」

117:t_1:131.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We both still have a long way to go, though.」

117:t_1:132.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Thank you, $n... I'm sure we'll become true partners someday...)

117:t_1:133.en:
$$スズネ$$
(So when that day comes, tell me everything you're carrying in your heart...)

117:t_2:3.en: ～$$オーティス$$　$$ターミナル・ベース$$～

117:t_2:4.en:
$n
「...Thank you, Lieutenant $$パトリック#colasour$$. You really helped me.」

117:t_2:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't mention it. You and I are allies in our love for beautiful older women with glasses.」

117:t_2:6.en:
$n
「When did I join a team like that...?!」

117:t_2:7.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Huh... You two seemed to be getting along nicely today, though.」

117:t_2:8.en:
$$マリー$$
「Don't tease him too much, $$アレルヤ$$. $n already has another girlfriend.」

117:t_2:9.en:
$n
「Ah... You don't need to worry about her anymore...」

117:t_2:11.en:
$n
「I haven't been able to get in touch with her lately...」

117:t_2:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So it just fizzled out...」

117:t_2:13.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'm sorry, $n. I didn't know that was what was happening...」

117:t_2:15.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Are you obsessed with a beautiful older woman with glasses?」

117:t_2:16.en:
$n
「That's not it...! Right now, I'm trying to focus on the battle...」

117:t_2:17.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'm kidding. Well... It's true that we'll be fighting as comrades from now on. I'm counting on you, $c.」

117:t_2:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Welcome, Lieutenant $$パトリック・マネキン$$.」

117:t_2:19.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It feels good to be called by my full name. It really makes me feel married.」

117:t_2:20.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You're as easygoing as ever.」

117:t_2:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you still reluctant to face $$刹那$$?」

117:t_2:24.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I still cannot take pride in who I am.」

117:t_2:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ゼクス$$ has told me about you. I'd like you to help command the unit from now on.」

117:t_2:26.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I won't claim the position is beyond me. I humbly accept.」

117:t_2:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then I'm counting on you, Major $$グラハム$$.」

117:t_2:28.en:
$$グラハム$$
「And I'm counting on you too.」

117:t_2:29.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Are you done saying hello, $$グラハム・エーカー$$? Then let's go see $$刹那$$.」

117:t_2:31.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You still can't make up your mind? You're like an innocent boy with an unrequited crush.」

117:t_2:32.en:
$$グラハム$$
「An unrequited crush... That's an apt way to put it.」

117:t_2:33.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Well, that's fine. Take all the time you need until you're satisfied.」

117:t_2:34.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But here's some advice from a man who won a woman out of his league. If you keep loving someone, your feelings will reach them.」
